scopeNote: No second Driver, no billing proxy, no new grant. wave03-b-native historical limit 4 stays with an UNKNOWN/unverified remainder and is not spendable; E's pilot grant is untouched.

singlePath.principle: one path for session, sealed copy, host isolation and budget; six independent gates, none short-circuits; a satisfied price never unlocks a missing isolation proof
singlePath.noCliFallback: call() refuses turn/start; startTurn is the only billing path and requires a reservation hook, so a missing adapter cannot fall back to a direct CLI send

measuredFacts.evidenceLayer: actual_native (real binary responses) + package-local (local filesystem/e2e) + protocol_fixture
measuredFacts.checkpointNote: measured on a separate clean thread: setting a goal persists thread state and makes an otherwise-empty thread resumable, which confounds a measurement taken after goal setup

B1.label: fixed execution identity and unified admission input
B1.unifiedResult: REFUSED with every gate reported separately; identity digest binds the verdict to executable path/version/digest/model/provider
whatNonBillingProves: initialize / thread/start / thread/read / thread/resume / thread/goal get-set-clear prove the transport, the session identity and the protocol surface
they do NOT prove a real author checkpoint: a 0-turn thread has no rollout, so resume/fork refuse

gapsListedSeparately.executableLimit: absent (turn/start has no token cap field)
gapsListedSeparately.session: proven for identity and arm separation

B1.noFallback: E must not reach the CLI directly; the refusal above is the only supported answer on this host

B2.label: session and host isolation bound to the same runner
sameLaunchPath: host: buildSeatbeltProfile (deny network, deny author home read/write, deny author project write, allow capsule scratch)
budget: reservation hook required before any billing write
B2.armSeparation: author continuation uses a persistent turn-backed thread; the fresh reviewer uses an ephemeral thread and carries no author thread id
B2.hostResult: deny network / deny author-home read / deny author-project write / allow capsule scratch, all under kernel enforcement

B3.label: copy-builder and isolation counter-cases closed
B3.resolution: the wave-06 FAIL is not relabelled. The OS is not required to forbid hardlinks; the production builder only copies bytes and REFUSES a link-based copyMode at admission
B3.unsafeNegativeControl: retained and still able to demonstrate the hazard (a link builder does share an inode), so the refusal is not a tautology
B3.assertionStrength: known-unsafe modes must be refused with the specific sealed-copy rationale, because an 'unknown copyMode' message also names the mode and would mask a broken check

B4.label: cost-bound feasibility decision within a bounded investigation
reasons: turn/start has no per-request token cap field, so no single-turn ceiling can be expressed
config/read (35654 bytes) exposes no token-limit key, so no config-level ceiling exists
thread/goal tokenBudget is cumulative across a goal: the first turn starts at tokensUsed=0 so it cannot cap that turn
usage arrives post-turn, so it measures spend without capping it
no price surface exists in the protocol, model list or config, and account usage/rate-limit reads need ChatGPT auth
notTested: whether a goal budget is checked before the first inference of a turn
whether exceeding the budget aborts an in-flight turn
actual billed amount for any real turn
B4.alternativeRecipeNote: both are zero-model verifiable, change no provider/model/protocol, need main to version the measurement design, and neither yields a single-turn hard bound
B4.unlockRule: pricing alone cannot unlock execution; runtime_bound_unavailable stays until a per-turn ceiling is expressible

B5.notTestedNative: real vendor stop/question/steer/unknown-send were not exercised; B does not spend E's pilot grant to fill this, and a new state does not prove old writers stopped
